subject: AP system integration — invoice delivery and VAT handling
messages:
From: Melissa Ortega <melissa.ortega@atlashealth.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: david.chen@atlashealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup / invoice delivery for Redwood Inference

Hi Laura,

We are kicking off vendor onboarding for Redwood so AP can ingest invoices into our Coupa instance. Two quick questions to confirm before we start:

1) What delivery methods do you support for invoices? (email copy, SFTP drop, cXML/PEPPOL/Coupa punchout, vendor portal)
2) For EU transactions, what is Redwood's VAT treatment? Do you issue VAT on invoices or do you support reverse-charge if we provide our EU VAT ID?

Attached are our AP requirements (file: atlas_ap_requirements.pdf) — they include the preferred field mappings and EDI identifiers. If possible, please let me know the technical contact/finance contact on your side and whether you can produce a sample invoice (PDF) in the format our system expects so we can validate mapping.

Best,
Melissa Ortega
Senior AP Analyst | Atlas Health
melissa.ortega@atlashealth.com
[Attachment: atlas_ap_requirements.pdf (PDF, 210KB)]

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Ortega <melissa.ortega@atlashealth.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / invoice delivery for Redwood Inference

Hi Melissa — thanks for reaching out and for the AP spec. Happy to get this moving.

Quick answers up-front: we support email, portal copies, SFTP delivery, and cXML/Coupa integrations (we can push invoices into Coupa via cXML). We also support Peppol for EU customers on request.

VAT: Redwood is a US-headquartered vendor. For EU customers, we can issue invoices net of VAT if you provide a valid EU VAT ID and confirm reverse-charge applies. If reverse-charge is not applicable, we will include US sales tax/VAT as required for the jurisdiction. We will need your legal billing name and VAT ID to apply reverse-charge.

Next steps I suggest:
- Please complete and return our vendor onboarding form (attached). It captures remit-to, VAT ID, invoice email(s), preferred delivery method, and any PO/EDI identifiers.
- If you'd like automated delivery into Coupa, indicate that in the form and include your cXML endpoint and credentials/partner ID.

Copying Marcus Lin (Finance) on this thread for the technical invoice sample and revenue-side details. Marcus — can you share a sample invoice PDF and confirm whether we can produce cXML / SFTP feed for Atlas?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Director, Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Melissa Ortega <melissa.ortega@atlashealth.com>

Cc: david.chen@atlashealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / invoice delivery for Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — that’s helpful. Confirming: Atlas prefers a cXML push into Coupa where possible; fallback to SFTP with a consistent filename convention is also acceptable.

We are EU-registered for certain entities and will provide the VAT ID in the onboarding form. For the division that will be paying Redwood, reverse-charge will be applicable provided the vendor invoice indicates no VAT and we provide the VAT ID on our side. Please confirm whether Redwood needs any additional declarations on the invoice to make reverse-charge explicit (e.g., a line referencing "VAT Reverse Charge" or a code).

Also: can you provide any vendor ID you use, and a contact for EDI/Coupa testing? Our technical lead David can run a test once you send a sample.

Regards,
Melissa
[Attachment: atlas_ap_requirements.pdf (re-sent)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Melissa Ortega <melissa.ortega@atlashealth.com>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: neha.kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 07:41:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup / invoice delivery for Redwood Inference

Hi Melissa,

Marcus from Finance here — nice to e-meet. We can absolutely support cXML pushes to Coupa and SFTP drops. A few operational details to make the integration smooth: 

- Vendor identifiers: we use VENDOR-RWI-<numeric> internally; we'll provision a vendor ID once the onboarding form is returned.
- Invoice metadata we include: invoice number, invoice date, PO number, Redwood remit-to (Redwood Inference, 450 Market St, San Francisco, CA), Redwood VAT ID: US-EIN 94-1234567 (for EU VAT reverse charge you should place your VAT ID in the "Bill-to" fields and we will leave VAT amount blank and include the reverse-charge note).
- Reverse-charge wording: we will add the statement "VAT reverse charge applies — customer liable for VAT under Article 194 (if applicable)" in the invoice footer when you provide an EU VAT ID. If you need a different legal citation, let us know.
- File formats: we can generate PDF + cXML. For SFTP we follow the naming convention: RWI_ATLAS_YYYYMMDD_INV_<invoice#>.xml.

Attached is a representative sample invoice (PDF) for format review. For Coupa testing, our EDI tech is Neha Kapoor (neha.kapoor@redwood.com) — she can coordinate endpoint, auth, and a test push.

Next steps checklist:
1) Melissa: return vendor_onboarding_form with VAT ID and preferred delivery method.
2) We will provision vendor ID and return sample cXML and PDF.
3) Neha will schedule a 30-min test window with your David for the Coupa push.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
[Attachment: sample_invoice_202611.pdf (PDF, 95KB)]
